newsitem.title: USA: Suffolk Downs operators buy out owners - paper.
newsitem.headline: Suffolk Downs operators buy out owners - paper.

text.p: The operators of Suffolk Downs have reached a deal to buy the 190-acre East Boston track from a partnership headed by controversial ex-Boston Red Sox owner Edward LeRoux, Jr, The Boston Globe reported on Wednesday.

Sterling Suffolk Racecourse Limited Partnership principals James Mosely and John Hall said their $40 million purchase from LeRoux's Belle Isle Limited Partnership would help stablize the track, which earned less than $1 million despite total wagers of $170 million in 1995, the newspaper reported.
Belle Isle owns the land and facilities at Suffolk Downs. Sterling leases the complex for its racing business.
Sterling is betting that the racetrack will be authorized to operate hundreds of slot machines, perhaps as soon as next spring, under proposed gambling legislation, the newspaper said.
